new_libraries.name: SEFR
new_libraries.author: Hamidreza Keshavarz <hamid9999@gmail.com>
new_libraries.sentence: Machine learning (TinyML) classifier that trains on the microcontroller itself, in one pass over the data.
new_libraries.paragraph: SEFR (arXiv:2006.04620) brings on-device learning and AI to small boards: learn a multiclass linear classifier from sensor samples streamed one at a time, with no learning rate, no iterations and no dynamic memory. An optional second pass (LDA) improves multiclass accuracy. Runs on 2 KB RAM boards such as the Uno, and on ESP32, RP2040 and nRF52. The SEFR algorithm is also used in STMicroelectronics NanoEdge AI Studio.
